title: Imvelo yethu
description: Ten short stories about the environment in daily life: rowing through a foggy wetland full of hippos, a January vegetable garden and a lazy teenager, a cook's grandmother's recipe that wastes nothing, a village gathering about stolen forest trees, a first summer storm in Pretoria, a straying goat in a game reserve, a healer in training gathering plants with care, cycling to work and sorting parcel waste, a drunkard who cleans the river, and courting a Sotho teacher in the autumn mountains.

lessons.title: Isikebhe exhaphozini
lessons.summary: On holiday in Kosi, Qhamukile rows into the wetland with his old, white-bearded grandfather Mthiyane: they set off with a packed lunch in thick fog, see ducks once it lifts, he learns to row, a hippo gapes at them where the water is deep, and they eat their provisions under a tree.
lessons.text:
UQhamukile uneminyaka eyishumi. Ngamaholide kaZibandlela uvakashela umkhulu wakhe, uMthiyane, eKosi. UMthiyane uyixhegu elineminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili. Unentshebe ende emhlophe, futhi uhlala eduze nexhaphozi elikhulu.

Ixhaphozi yindawo enamanzi amaningi notshani obude. Leli xhaphozi liphithizela izilwane: izinyoni, izinhlanzi nezinyoka. Ebusuku ixhaphozi lonke liphithizela imisindo yezilwane.

Ngolunye usuku uMkhulu uthi: "Qhamukile, kusasa sizogwedla exhaphozini ngesikebhe sami. Ngizokukhombisa izilwane." Ngakusasa ekuseni uGogo ubalungiselela umphako: isinkwa, amaqanda abilisiwe nebhodlela lamanzi. UQhamukile uthatha umphako, awufake esikebheni.

Kusekuseni kakhulu, futhi inkungu igcwele ixhaphozi. Abakwazi ukubona kude ngenxa yenkungu. UQhamukile uthi: "Mkhulu, angiboni lutho enkungwini!" UMkhulu uthi: "Ungesabi. Leli xhaphozi ngiyalazi kahle. Ngigwedle lapha iminyaka eminingi." Bangena esikebheni esincane, futhi uMkhulu uqala ukugwedla kancane enkungwini.

Ngemuva kwehora inkungu iyaphela, futhi ilanga liyaphuma. UQhamukile ubona amadada amaningi emanzini. Amadada abhukuda ndawonye, futhi elinye idada lifaka ikhanda lalo emanzini, lifuna ukudla. UQhamukile uyahleka.

UMkhulu uthi: "Manje gwedla wena." UQhamukile uzama ukugwedla, kodwa isikebhe siyazungeza. Ixhegu liyahleka, libambe intshebe yalo. UMkhulu umfundisa ukugwedla kahle. Ekugcineni uQhamukile uyakwazi ukugwedla, futhi isikebhe sihamba ngqo.

Bafika endaweni lapho amanzi ajulile khona. UQhamukile ubuza: "Mkhulu, inzulu yamanzi lapha iyini?" UMkhulu uthi: "Inzulu yawo idlula amamitha amathathu. Lapha kuhlala izimvubu."

Ngaleso sikhathi imvubu enkulu iphuma emanzini. Iyakhamisa. Umlomo wayo mkhulu kakhulu, futhi amazinyo ayo made. UQhamukile uyesaba. UMkhulu uthi: "Imvubu ikhamisa ukuze isitshele ukuthi le ndawo ngeyayo. Masihambe." Ugwedla ngokushesha, futhi bayasuka emvubini.

Emini bahlala ngaphansi kwesihlahla eduze nexhaphozi, badle umphako wabo. Amadada abhukuda eduze nabo, futhi uQhamukile uwanika isinkwa esincane.

Kusihlwa uQhamukile utshela uGogo: "Ixhaphozi liphithizela izilwane! Ngabona amadada, ngabona imvubu ikhamisa, futhi ngagwedla isikebhe ngedwa."

Imibuzo:
UMthiyane ungubani?
Ungumkhulu kaQhamukile, ixhegu elinentshebe ende emhlophe.
Kungani bengaboni kude ekuseni?
Ababoni kude ngenxa yenkungu egcwele ixhaphozi.
UQhamukile ubonani emanzini ngemuva kwenkungu?
Ubona amadada amaningi.
Inzulu yamanzi iyini lapho kuhlala khona izimvubu?
Idlula amamitha amathathu.
Kungani imvubu ikhamisa?
Ikhamisa ukuze ibatshele ukuthi le ndawo ngeyayo.

lessons.title: Isivande ngoMasingana
lessons.summary: In the January heat in Pietermaritzburg, Nontando pays her lazy teenage neighbour Mqobi to water her garden; his laziness returns and the tomatoes wilt, but he then feeds a barren corner with manure, sprouts come up, and at the end of the month she gives him his money and a basket of tomatoes and figs.
lessons.text:
UNontando uneminyaka engamashumi amane. Uhlala endlini encane eMgungundlovu, futhi unesivande ngemuva kwendlu yakhe. Esivandeni utshala utamatisi, iklabishi nezinye izitshalo. Eduze nesivande kukhona isihlahla esidala samakhiwane. UNontando uthanda amakhiwane kakhulu, futhi avuthwa ngoMasingana.

UMasingana uyinyanga eshisa kakhulu. Ilanga liyashisa usuku lonke, futhi ngezinye izikhathi imvula ayini amasonto amaningi. Ngalesi sikhathi amanzi ayaswelakala esivandeni. Kuswelakala ukuthi isivande sichelelwe ekuseni nakusihlwa.

Kodwa ngoMasingana walo nyaka uNontando usebenza amahora amaningi. Akanaso isikhathi sokuchelela isivande. Ngakho ubiza umfana womakhelwane wakhe, uMqobi. UMqobi uneminyaka eyishumi nesithupha, futhi uyivila. Ulala kuze kube semini, futhi akathandi ukusebenza.

UNontando uthi kuye: "Mqobi, ngizokukhokhela imali uma ungichelela isivande ekuseni nakusihlwa." UMqobi uyavuma, ngoba ufuna imali yokuthenga izicathulo ezintsha.

Ngosuku lokuqala uMqobi uchelela kahle. Ngosuku lwesibili uyachelela futhi. Kodwa ngosuku lwesithathu ubuvila bakhe buyabuya. Uyalala, futhi akacheleli. Ubuvila buyamnqoba. Utamatisi uyoma, futhi amakhiwane ayawa phansi. UNontando uthi: "Mqobi, ubuvila bakho buzobulala izitshalo zami! Ingabe uyivila ngempela?" UMqobi unamahloni.

Endaweni eyodwa yesivande umhlabathi unyumbile. Akukho lutho olukhulayo lapho. UMqobi uthi: "Ngizokusiza. Ngizolungisa lo mhlabathi onyumbile." Ufaka umquba emhlabathini, bese ewuchelela nsuku zonke. Uchelela ekuseni, uchelela nakusihlwa. Manje uMqobi akasalali kuze kube semini.

Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili uMqobi ubona ihlumela elincane kulo mhlabathi. Ngakusasa ubona amahlumela amaningi. Uthi: "Nontando, buka! Amahlumela!" UNontando uyajabula. Uthi: "Ngiyabubona ubungcono, Mqobi. Ubungcono besivande buyabonakala. Lobu bungcono buvela emsebenzini wakho. Isivande siba ngcono nsuku zonke, nawe uba ngcono."

Ekupheleni kukaMasingana utamatisi ubomvu futhi mkhulu, namakhiwane avuthiwe. UNontando unika uMqobi imali yakhe, kanye nobhasikidi ogcwele utamatisi namakhiwane. UMqobi uthatha ubhasikidi, futhi uthi: "Ngonyaka ozayo ngizokwenza isivande sami."

Imibuzo:
Amakhiwane kaNontando avuthwa nini?
Avuthwa ngoMasingana.
Kungani amanzi eswelakala esivandeni ngoMasingana?
Ngoba uMasingana uyinyanga eshisa kakhulu, futhi imvula ayini.
UMqobi ungumuntu onjani ekuqaleni?
Uyivila: ulala kuze kube semini, futhi akathandi ukusebenza.
Kwenzekani emhlabathini onyumbile?
UMqobi wafaka umquba, wachelela, futhi kwaphuma amahlumela.
UNontando unikani uMqobi ekugcineni?
Umnika imali nobhasikidi ogcwele utamatisi namakhiwane.

lessons.title: Iresiphi kagogo
lessons.summary: Nhlonipho, a cook at a restaurant by the sea in Durban, makes his grandmother's recipe of fish and potatoes in the oven for his boss Msimang: he buys a kilogram of fish, peels the potatoes and keeps the peels for compost, mixes butter and salt, and washes the dishes in one basin of water instead of under the running tap.
lessons.text:
UNhlonipho uneminyaka engamashumi amathathu. Ungumpheki endaweni yokudlela eduze nolwandle eThekwini. Ungumpheki omuhle, futhi amakhasimende amaningi athanda ukudla kwakhe.

Ngolunye usuku uMsimang, onendawo yokudlela, uthi kuye: "Nhlonipho, sifuna ukudla okusha kwamakhasimende ethu. Kodwa angifuni ukuchitha ukudla namanzi. Ungasiphekelani?"

UNhlonipho ukhumbula iresiphi kagogo wakhe. Ugogo wayepheka ufishi namazambane kuhhavini. Iresiphi yakhe ilula: ufishi, amazambane, ibhotela nosawoti. UNhlonipho uthi: "Ngizopheka ufishi kagogo."

Ekuseni uya olwandle, lapho abadobi bethengisa khona ufishi. Uthenga ikhilogremu elilodwa likafishi omusha. Uthenga namakhilogremu amabili amazambane esitolo. Ubuyela ekhishini lendawo yokudlela.

Ekhishini ugeza amazambane, bese ewacwecwa ngommese. Ucwecwa izambane ngalinye kancane, ukuze angachithi ukudla. Akalahli lokho akucwecwile, kodwa uyakufaka ebhakedeni, ukuze akufake emqubeni wesivande. Uthi: "Umquba uzondla izitshalo zethu."

Bese uthatha ibhotela nosawoti. Uncibilikisa ibhotela, bese elixuba nosawoti. Ibhotela nosawoti kuyadibana kahle uma ibhotela lincibilikile. Iresiphi kagogo ithi: "Ibhotela nosawoti kufanele kudibane kahle, bese uthela lokhu phezu kofishi namazambane." UNhlonipho wenza njengoba iresiphi isho.

Ufaka ufishi namazambane kuhhavini. Uhhavini ushisa kakhulu. Ngemuva kwemizuzu engamashumi amathathu ukhipha ukudla kuhhavini. Ukudla kunuka kamnandi kakhulu.

Ngesikhathi ufishi usaphekwa kuhhavini, uNhlonipho ugeza izitsha. Akawavuli amanzi isikhathi eside. Ugcwalisa indishi ngamanzi, bese egeza zonke izitsha endishini. Uthi: "Indishi eyodwa yamanzi yanele zonke izitsha. Uma amanzi egobhoza isikhathi eside, ayachitheka."

UMsimang udla ufishi. Uthi: "Lokhu kumnandi kakhulu! Iresiphi kabani le?" UNhlonipho uthi: "Iresiphi kagogo wami. Ayichithi ukudla, futhi ayichithi amanzi." UMsimang uyajabula. Uthi: "Ungumpheki wangempela."

Kusukela ngalolo suku ufishi kagogo uba ukudla okuthandwa kakhulu endaweni yokudlela. Amakhasimende afika ngoLwesihlanu nangoMgqibelo, futhi bonke bafuna ufishi ophekwe kuhhavini.

Imibuzo:
UNhlonipho wenzani emsebenzini?
Ungumpheki endaweni yokudlela eThekwini.
Iresiphi kagogo wakhe idingani?
Idinga ufishi, amazambane, ibhotela nosawoti.
UNhlonipho uthengani olwandle?
Uthenga ikhilogremu elilodwa likafishi omusha.
Wenzani ngalokho akucwecwile emazambaneni?
Uyakufaka ebhakedeni, ukuze akufake emqubeni wesivande.
Kungani egeza izitsha endishini?
Ngoba indishi eyodwa yamanzi yanele zonke izitsha, futhi akafuni ukuchitha amanzi.

lessons.title: Imbizo ngehlathi
lessons.summary: Men from town steal the trees of a village forest at night; the chief's son Khulekile calls a gathering, the crowd makes an uproar, the lawyer Gasa explains that the forest belongs to the community, and the wise old woman Nosiphiwo says the villagers must plant trees too, since they also cut many with their axes.
lessons.text:
Esigodini esiseduze nehlathi elikhulu, abantu basebenzisa izihlahla zehlathi iminyaka eminingi. Bagawula izihlahla ngezimbazo zabo. Bakha izindlu zabo ngezigxobo zezihlahla, bese bezifulela ngotshani. Uma umuntu efulela indlu yakhe, omakhelwane bayamsiza.

Kodwa kulo nyaka kunenkinga. Amadoda avela edolobheni afika ebusuku nezimbazo namaloli. Agawula izihlahla eziningi, futhi athengisa izinkuni edolobheni. Lokhu kungukuntshontsha. Ihlathi liya lincipha njalo.

Inkosi yesigodi indala futhi iyagula, ngakho indodana yayo, inkosana uKhulekile, ibiza imbizo. NgoMgqibelo wonke umgwamanda wesigodi uhlangana embizweni ngaphansi kwesihlahla esikhulu.

Inkosana iyasukuma, ishumayeze umgwamanda: "Bantu besigodi, ukuntshontsha izihlahla zethu kufanele kuphele. Uma ihlathi liphela, sizothola kuphi izigxobo zezindlu zethu? Sizopheka ngani?"

Abantu bayaxokozela. Omunye uthi: "Masibashaye!" Omunye uthi: "Masibize amaphoyisa!" Imbizo yonke iyaxokozela, futhi akekho ozwa omunye. Inkosana iphakamisa isandla, ithi: "Thulani!" Abantu bayathula.

Bese kukhuluma igqwetha lesigodi, uGasa. Igqwetha lithi: "Umthetho uthi leli hlathi lingelomgwamanda wonke. Ukuntshontsha izihlahla kuyicala. Ngizobhalela amaphoyisa, futhi ngizobasiza ecaleni." Abantu bayavuma. Bayalithemba igqwetha labo. Inkosana iyabonga, bese ishumayeza umgwamanda futhi: "Masibabambe labo bantu ndawonye."

Ekugcineni kusukuma isalukazi, uNosiphiwo. Wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi uNosiphiwo uyisihlakaniphi. Lesi sihlakaniphi sithi: "Igqwetha likhuluma kahle. Kodwa nathi kufanele sitshale izihlahla ezintsha. Nathi sigawula izihlahla eziningi ngezimbazo zethu, futhi asitshali lutho." Abantu bathula. Inkosana ithi: "Lena yinhlakanipho yangempela." Abantu bayavuma, ngoba bayayihlonipha inhlakanipho yesalukazi.

Emasontweni alandelayo izinsizwa zibheka ihlathi ebusuku. Ngobunye ubusuku zibamba amadoda amabili anezimbazo nemoto. Amaphoyisa ayawathatha. Abesifazane nezingane batshala izihlahla ezincane eduze nehlathi.

Ngonyaka olandelayo uKhulekile ufulela indlu kanina ngotshani obusha, futhi usebenzisa izigxobo ezimbalwa kuphela. Uthi: "Inhlakanipho kaNosiphiwo isindisile ihlathi lethu."

Imibuzo:
Kungani inkosana ibiza imbizo?
Ngoba amadoda avela edolobheni ayantshontsha izihlahla zehlathi.
Kwenzekani lapho inkosana ishumayeza umgwamanda?
Abantu bayaxokozela, futhi akekho ozwa omunye.
Igqwetha lithini ngehlathi?
Lithi ihlathi lingelomgwamanda wonke, futhi ukuntshontsha izihlahla kuyicala.
Isihlakaniphi uNosiphiwo sithini?
Sithi nabantu besigodi kufanele batshale izihlahla ezintsha.
Abantu bafulela izindlu zabo ngani?
Bazifulela ngotshani.

lessons.title: Isiphepho sikaLwezi
lessons.summary: London-born Gcinokuhle visits her grandmother in Pretoria in November and sees her first summer storm: lightning flashes from cloud to cloud, her grandmother keeps her from going out with a metal umbrella, and after the rain she watches an owl perched in a tree turn its neck, picks up its long feather and sees a small tortoise.
lessons.text:
UGcinokuhle uneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye. Wazalelwa eLondon, futhi uhlala khona nabazali bakhe. NgoLwezi walo nyaka uvakashela ugogo wakhe ePitoli okokuqala.

NgoLwezi kuyashisa ePitoli emini, kodwa ngemuva kwemini izulu liyaduma, futhi kuna imvula enkulu. ELondon imvula iyana kancane, kodwa akukho siphepho esinjalo. Ngakho uGcinokuhle uqabuka ukubona isiphepho sikaLwezi.

Ngosuku lokuqala ngemuva kwemini amafu amnyama agcwala esibhakabhakeni. Bese uGcinokuhle ubona unyazi. Unyazi lukhanya phakathi kwamafu, lusuka kwelinye ifu luye kwelinye. UGcinokuhle uyamangala. Uthi: "Gogo, ngiqabuka ukubona unyazi olunje!"

UGogo uthi: "NgoLwezi siba nonyazi oluningi. Unyazi luhle, kodwa izulu liyingozi. Uma izulu liduma, sihlala endlini."

UGcinokuhle uthatha isambulela sakhe. Ufuna ukuphuma, abuke unyazi. Kodwa uGogo uthi: "Cha! Ungaphumi nesambulela ngesikhathi sezulu. Isambulela sakho sinensimbi, futhi insimbi iyingozi lapho izulu liduma." UGcinokuhle ubeka isambulela phansi, futhi uhlala noGogo endlini. Bobabili babuka unyazi.

Ngemuva kwehora imvula iyaphela, futhi izulu liyathula. UGogo uthi: "Manje singaphuma." Baphuma bonke ngaphandle.

Esihlahleni esiseduze nendlu kuqhwakele isikhova esikhulu. Isikhova siqhwakele phezulu, futhi asinyakazi. Amehlo aso makhulu futhi ayakhanya. Bese isikhova sijika umqala waso, sibheke ngemuva. UGcinokuhle uthi: "Gogo, isikhova sijika umqala waso kakhulu!" Uzama ukujika umqala wakhe, kodwa awukwazi ukujika kanjalo. UGogo uyahleka.

Ngaphansi kwesihlahla uGcinokuhle uthola usiba olude. UGogo uthi: "Lolu siba ngolwesikhova." UGcinokuhle uthatha usiba, alufake esikhwameni sakhe. Ufuna ukulukhombisa abangane bakhe eLondon.

Eduze kwendlela kuhamba ufudu oluncane. UGogo uthi: "Ufudu luphuma ngemuva kwemvula, ngoba lufuna amanzi nokudla." UGcinokuhle uqabuka ukubona ufudu. Ufudu luhamba kancane kakhulu, futhi uGcinokuhle uluyeka luhambe.

Kusihlwa uGcinokuhle ubhalela umama wakhe eLondon: "NgoLwezi ngaqabuka ukubona unyazi, isikhova nofudu. Ngithole nosiba lwesikhova."

Imibuzo:
UGcinokuhle uvakashela ugogo wakhe nini?
Umvakashela ngoLwezi.
Unyazi lwenzani esibhakabhakeni?
Lukhanya phakathi kwamafu, lusuka kwelinye ifu luye kwelinye.
Kungani uGogo engafuni ukuthi uGcinokuhle aphume nesambulela?
Ngoba isambulela sinensimbi, futhi insimbi iyingozi lapho izulu liduma.
Isikhova senzani esihlahleni?
Siqhwakele phezulu, futhi sijika umqala waso, sibheke ngemuva.
Kungani ufudu luphuma ngemuva kwemvula?
Lufuna amanzi nokudla.

lessons.title: Imbuzi eyedukayo
lessons.summary: Ntshangase, a former hunter who now guards the animals of the Ndumo reserve, helps the farmer Mdletshe look for a goat that strayed: he loads his gun, they pass an ostrich and a buffalo sniffing the wind, follow circling vultures, find jackals surrounding the goat and scare them off with a shot into the air, and see a skin a snake has shed.
lessons.text:
UNtshangase uneminyaka engamashumi ayisihlanu. Usebenza endaweni yezilwane zasendle eNdumo. Kudala wayengumzingeli. Wayezingela izinyamazane, azithengise. Kodwa manje akasazingeli: uvikela izilwane. Uthi: "Umzingeli uyazazi izilwane kahle. Ngakho ngiyakwazi ukuzivikela."

Ngolunye usuku umlimi ohlala eduze nendawo yezilwane, uMdletshe, uza kuye. Uthi: "Mngane wami, imbuzi yami encane yeduka izolo. Ngicabanga ukuthi yangena endaweni yezilwane." UNtshangase uthi: "Masiyifune ngokushesha. Imbuzi eyedukayo ayiphili isikhathi eside lapha, ngoba izimpungushe ziyazithanda izimbuzi."

UNtshangase uthatha isibhamu sakhe, futhi uyasihlohla. Uthi: "Angifuni ukudubula silwane. Kodwa isibhamu kufanele sihlohlwe uma kuba nengozi."

Bahamba endaweni yezilwane. Babona intshe enkulu igijima etshanini. UNtshangase uthi: "Intshe iyinyoni enkulu kunazo zonke, kodwa ayikwazi ukundiza." Intshe igijima ngejubane elikhulu, futhi uMdletshe uyamangala.

Bese babona izinyathi eziningi eduze kwamanzi. Inyathi enkulu iphakamisa ikhanda layo, futhi iphakamisa impumulo yayo emoyeni. UNtshangase uthi: "Inyathi inempumulo enhle kakhulu. Isizwa ngempumulo yayo ngaphambi kokuthi isibone." Bahamba kancane, ngoba inyathi iyingozi kakhulu.

Esibhakabhakeni kukhona amanqe amaningi. Amanqe azungeza phezulu. UNtshangase uthi: "Lapho amanqe ezungeza khona, kukhona okuthile phansi. Amanqe abona ukudla kude." Bagijima baye lapho.

Ngaphansi kwesihlahla babona imbuzi kaMdletshe. Izimpungushe ezintathu ziyiphahlile. Izimpungushe ziyiphahla, futhi imbuzi iyakhala. UNtshangase uphakamisa isibhamu esihlohliwe, adubule phezulu emoyeni. Izimpungushe ziyabaleka, futhi amanqe nawo ayandiza.

UMdletshe uthatha imbuzi yakhe. Isesaba, kodwa iphilile. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga, mngane wami. Imbuzi yeduka, kodwa uyitholile."

Endleleni yokubuya babona isikhumba senyoka phansi. UNtshangase uthi: "Inyoka ihlubile. Izinyoka zihluba isikhumba sazo ngoba ziyakhula. Inyoka ihluba, ishiye isikhumba esidala, bese ihamba nesikhumba esisha."

Kusihlwa uMdletshe ubopha imbuzi yakhe eduze nendlu, ukuze ingaphindi yeduke.

Imibuzo:
UNtshangase wayenzani kudala?
Wayengumzingeli, futhi wayezingela izinyamazane.
Kungani isibhamu kufanele sihlohlwe?
Kufanele sihlohlwe uma kuba nengozi.
Inyathi yenzani ngempumulo yayo?
Iyiphakamisa emoyeni, futhi ibazwa ngempumulo ngaphambi kokuthi ibabone.
Bathola kanjani imbuzi kaMdletshe?
Babona amanqe ezungeza phezulu, bese begijima baye lapho.
Izimpungushe zenzani embuzini?
Ziyiphahlile, futhi imbuzi iyakhala.

lessons.title: Ithwasa nemithi yemvelo
lessons.summary: Snqobile, a healer in training in Nkandla, wears a leather skirt and a white headscarf and smears red ochre on herself; her teacher Sokhela greets the ancestors before they gather plants, teaches her to take only a little from each, has her rub medicine on a boy's swollen foot after a bee sting, and rids a girl's hair of lice.
lessons.text:
USnqobile uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Uyithwasa. Ithwasa ngumuntu ofunda ukuba yisangoma. USnqobile uhlala nesangoma esidala, uSokhela, eNkandla. Ufunda kuye iminyaka emibili.

Njengawo wonke amathwasa, uSnqobile ugqoka isidwaba sesikhumba. Ugqoka futhi iduku elimhlophe ekhanda. Iduku likaSnqobile lihlala limhlophe njalo. Isidwaba sakhe sidala, futhi siyisipho sikanina. Ekuseni ubheca ibomvu esidwabeni nasebusweni bakhe. Ibomvu lenziwa ngomhlabathi obomvu, futhi amathwasa amaningi ayalibheca.

Ngolunye usuku uSokhela uthi: "Namuhla sizothatha imithi ezintabeni." Ngaphambi kokuthi bahambe, uSokhela ukhuluma nezinyanya. Uthi: "Zinyanya zethu, siyabonga ngemithi yemvelo. Sisizeni namuhla." USnqobile uyalalela. Uyazi ukuthi izangoma zikhuluma nezinyanya njalo. USokhela uthi: "Izinyanya zethu zisibheka njalo. Uma sihlonipha imvelo, sihlonipha nezinyanya."

Ezintabeni uSokhela ukhombisa uSnqobile izitshalo eziningi. Uthi: "Imvelo isinika imithi. Kodwa kufanele siyihloniphe. Thatha kancane kuphela esitshalweni ngasinye. Uma uthatha konke, isitshalo siyafa, futhi ngonyaka ozayo ngeke sibe nemithi." USnqobile uthatha kancane esitshalweni ngasinye, njengoba uSokhela esho. Ubeka imithi esikhwameni sakhe, futhi babuyela ekhaya kusihlwa.

Kusihlwa kufika umama nendodana yakhe encane. Unyawo lwengane luvuvukile. Umama uthi: "Inyosi imlumile izolo. Namuhla unyawo lwakhe luvuvuke kakhulu." USokhela unika uSnqobile umuthi. Uthi: "Hlikihla umuthi onyaweni kancane." USnqobile uhlikihla unyawo kancane. Uhlikihla isikhathi eside, futhi ingane ayikhali. Ngakusasa unyawo alusavuvukile kakhulu. Umama uyabonga.

Ngelinye ilanga kufika intombazane encane. Ikhanda layo ligcwele izintwala. Izintwala ziyayiluma, futhi ayikwazi ukulala ebusuku. USokhela uthi: "Izintwala azithandi lo muthi." Ugeza izinwele zentombazane ngamanzi anomuthi. USnqobile ubuka kahle. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu akukho ntwala ekhanda lentombazane.

Ebusuku uSnqobile ubheca ibomvu esidwabeni sakhe futhi, abeke iduku lakhe eceleni. Bese ebonga izinyanya. Uthi: "Ngiyithwasa namuhla, kodwa ngolunye usuku ngizoba yisangoma esihle, njengoSokhela."

Imibuzo:
Ithwasa ngumuntu onjani?
Ngumuntu ofunda ukuba yisangoma.
USnqobile ugqokani?
Ugqoka isidwaba sesikhumba neduku elimhlophe ekhanda.
Wenzani ngebomvu ekuseni?
Ulibheca esidwabeni nasebusweni bakhe.
Kungani unyawo lwengane luvuvukile?
Ngoba inyosi yayilumile.
USokhela wenzani ngezintwala zentombazane?
Ugeza izinwele zayo ngamanzi anomuthi.

lessons.title: Ibhayisikili likaMabuza
lessons.summary: In August Mabuza of Umlazi decides to cycle the five miles to work for the sake of the planet: he polishes his old bicycle, has the bent front wheel heated and straightened at a blacksmith's forge, and at home he and his wife sort the boxes and plastic of their parcels in order, looking for the triangle that marks what can be used again.
lessons.text:
UMabuza uneminyaka engamashumi amane nesihlanu. Uhlala eMlazi nomfazi wakhe, futhi usebenza ehhovisi eThekwini. Indawo yakhe yomsebenzi ikude ngamamayela amahlanu. Iminyaka eminingi uMabuza uya emsebenzini ngemoto yakhe.

NgoNcwaba walo nyaka uMabuza ubuka izindaba kumabonakude. Izindaba zithi izimoto eziningi zingcolisa umoya, futhi lokhu kulimaza iplanethi yethu. UMabuza uthi kunkosikazi wakhe: "Sinendawo eyodwa kuphela yokuhlala, futhi iyiplanethi yethu. Kusukela kulo Ncwaba ngizohamba ngebhayisikili amamayela amahlanu nsuku zonke."

Egalaji kukhona ibhayisikili lakhe elidala. Linothuli, futhi insimbi yalo ayisakhanyi. UMabuza ulihlanza, bese eliphucuza ngendwangu. Uphucuza insimbi kuze kube yilapho ikhanya futhi. Kodwa isondo langaphambili lebhayisikili ligobile. UMabuza akakwazi ukuhamba kahle uma isondo ligobile.

Ngakho uthatha ibhayisikili, ahambe nalo esithandweni sendoda esebenza ngensimbi. Isithando yindawo lapho insimbi ishiswa khona emlilweni. Lesi sithando sidala kakhulu. Kuso kushisa kakhulu, futhi umlilo uvutha njalo. Le ndoda ishisisa insimbi yesondo emlilweni wesithando, bese iliqondisa ngesando. Ngemuva kwehora isondo liqondile. UMabuza uyajabula, futhi ukhokhela le ndoda imali encane.

Ekhaya inkosikazi kaMabuza ibheka amaphasela amaningi. Bathenga izinto eziningi ngocingo, futhi iphasela ngalinye lifika ebhokisini elikhulu, linamaphepha amaningi. UMabuza uthi: "Amaphasela ethu agcwalisa umgqomo kadoti nsuku zonke."

Bese bobabili behlela udoti ngenhlelo entsha. Amaphepha namabhokisi bawabeka ndawonye. Amabhodlela bawabeka ndawonye. Ukudla okusele bakufaka emqubeni. Lena yinhlelo elula. Inhlelo enjalo iyasiza, ngoba manje umgqomo kadoti awusagcwali ngokushesha.

Emabhodleleni nasemabhokisini kukhona unxantathu omncane. UMabuza uchazela inkosikazi yakhe: "Uma ubona unxantathu, lokho kusho ukuthi singayisebenzisa futhi le nto." Ngakho bafuna unxantathu kuyo yonke into ngaphambi kokuthi bayilahle. Amabhodlela anonxantathu bawathatha, baye nawo esitolo esiwathengayo.

Ekupheleni kukaNcwaba uMabuza usegibele ibhayisikili amamayela ayikhulu. Uthi: "Ngiba namandla, futhi iplanethi ithola umoya ohlanzekile."

Imibuzo:
Indawo yomsebenzi kaMabuza ikude ngamamayela amangaki?
Ikude ngamamayela amahlanu.
Kungani uMabuza efuna ukuhamba ngebhayisikili?
Ngoba izimoto zingcolisa umoya, futhi lokhu kulimaza iplanethi.
Wenzani ngensimbi yebhayisikili?
Uyayiphucuza ngendwangu kuze kube yilapho ikhanya.
Isondo eligobile liqondiswa kuphi?
Liqondiswa esithandweni sendoda esebenza ngensimbi.
Unxantathu emabhodleleni usho ukuthini?
Usho ukuthi singayisebenzisa futhi le nto.

lessons.title: Isidakwa nomfula
lessons.summary: Buthelezi, a drunkard in a township, leaves bottles and the ends of the tobacco he smokes by the river; children tease him and call him a madman, he becomes a laughing-stock and coughs badly, the preacher Mhlongo speaks to him kindly, and in his embarrassment, bearing the children no grudge, he stops drinking and cleans the river.
lessons.text:
UButhelezi uneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu. Uhlala yedwa endlini encane eduze nomfula. Uyisidakwa. Uphuza utshwala nsuku zonke kusukela ekuseni kuze kube sebusuku. Abantu bendawo bambiza ngokuthi isidakwa somfula.

Njalo kusihlwa uButhelezi uhlala ngasemfuleni. Uphuza utshwala, futhi ubhema ugwayi. Ugwayi obhenywa nguye uwuphonsa phansi, futhi ungcolisa indawo. Uma eqeda ukuphuza, uphonsa amabhodlela emfuleni. Umfula uyangcola, futhi izinhlanzi ziyafa.

Izingane zendawo ziyamchukuluza. Zithi: "Bheka uhlanya! Uhlanya luphonsa amabhodlela emanzini!" UButhelezi uyazithethisa, kodwa izingane zihleka kakhulu. Ziyaqhubeka nokumchukuluza. Uba yinhlekisa yendawo yonke, futhi akekho ofuna ukuba yinhlekisa. Abantu abadala nabo bayahleka uma bembona.

UButhelezi ukhwehlela kakhulu. Ukhwehlela ekuseni, ukhwehlela ebusuku. Udokotela uthi kuye: "Ugwayi obhenywayo nsuku zonke ulimaza umzimba wakho. Uma ungayeki, uzokhwehlela kuze kube sekufeni."

NgeSonto umshumayeli wendawo, uMhlongo, uza kuButhelezi ngasemfuleni. Akamthethisi. Uhlala naye phansi, bese ekhuluma naye kahle. Umshumayeli uthi: "Mngane wami, angizanga ngoba ngifuna ukukuthethisa. Ngifuna ukukutshela ukuthi uNkulunkulu uyakuthanda. Kodwa umfula wethu uyafa. Izinhlanzi ziyafa ngenxa yamabhodlela."

UButhelezi ubheka amabhodlela emanzini. Uzwa ukuphoxeka okukhulu. Uthi: "Ngempela ngiyinhlekisa. Izingane zikhuluma iqiniso." Ukuphoxeka kwakhe kukhulu, futhi ukuphoxeka kumenza athule isikhathi eside, kodwa akanalo igqubu ezinganeni. Uthi: "Anginalo igqubu kuzo. Ziyangichukuluza ngoba ngenza izinto ezimbi."

Ngakusasa uButhelezi akaphuzi utshwala. Uthatha isikhwama esikhulu, bese ekhipha amabhodlela onke emfuleni. Umshumayeli uyamsiza. Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili izingane ziyeza zizobasiza. Azisamchukuluzi.

Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu uButhelezi akaphuzi nhlobo. Abantu bathi: "Akusekho isidakwa somfula." Akasabhemi, futhi akasakhwehleli kakhulu. Umfula uhlanzekile, futhi izinhlanzi ziyabuya.

Imibuzo:
UButhelezi wenzani ngasemfuleni kusihlwa?
Uphuza utshwala, abheme ugwayi, futhi aphonse amabhodlela emfuleni.
Izingane zimbiza ngani?
Zimbiza ngokuthi uhlanya.
Kungani uButhelezi ekhwehlela kakhulu?
Ukhwehlela ngenxa yogwayi obhenywa nguye nsuku zonke.
Umshumayeli uMhlongo wenzani?
Uhlala naye phansi, futhi ukhuluma naye kahle ngomfula.
UButhelezi unalo igqubu ezinganeni na?
Cha, akanalo igqubu kuzo, ngoba ziyamchukuluza ngenxa yezinto ezimbi azenzayo.

lessons.title: Ukuqomisa ngoNhlaba
lessons.summary: In May, as autumn comes to the mountains at Sani, hotel worker Nkosiyethu, who is popular for his charm, wants to court Nthabiseng, a new Sotho teacher from Maseru who also speaks Shona; he learns Sotho to greet her, they walk the mountains teaching each other words, his friend Majozi is envious, and by the end of the month she loves him.
lessons.text:
UNkosiyethu uneminyaka engamashumi amabili nesishiyagalombili. Usebenza ehhotela elincane phezulu ezintabeni zaseSani, eduze nezwe labeSuthu. Abantu abaningi abasebenza ehhotela bangabeSuthu.

NgoNhlaba ikwindla ifika ezintabeni. Ekwindla utshani buba nsundu, futhi ebusuku kuyabanda kakhulu. NgoNhlaba walo nyaka kufika umfundisi omusha esikoleni esincane eduze nehhotela. Igama lakhe nguNthabiseng. UngumSuthu ovela eMaseru. Ukhuluma isiSuthu, isiNgisi nesiZulu esincane. Wafunda eHarare, ngakho ukhuluma nesiShona.

UNkosiyethu ubona uNthabiseng okokuqala esitolo. Uthi kumngane wakhe uMajozi: "Ngifuna ukuqomisa le nkosazana." UMajozi uthi: "Uyinkosazana enhle kakhulu. Kodwa yena ungumSuthu, wena ungumZulu. Akasazi kahle isiZulu."

UNkosiyethu unogazi. Abantu bayamthanda, ngoba uyahleka futhi ukhuluma kahle nabo bonke. Abantu bathi: "UNkosiyethu unogazi." Kodwa noma unogazi, akasazi isiSuthu. Ufuna ukukhuluma noNthabiseng ngolimi lwakhe.

Ngakho uNkosiyethu ufunda isiSuthu. Uthenga incwadi yesiSuthu, futhi ufunda amagama amasha ebusuku. Ngesonto elilandelayo uya kuNthabiseng, ambingelele ngesiSuthu. UNthabiseng uyamangala, futhi uyahleka. Uthi: "Ukhuluma isiSuthu! AmaZulu amaningi awasikhulumi." UNkosiyethu uthi: "Ngifuna ukukwazi kangcono. Ngifuna ukufunda nesiShona!" UNthabiseng uthi: "Qala ngesiSuthu kuqala."

UNkosiyethu uqala ukumqomisa. NgoMgqibelo bahamba ndawonye ezintabeni. Ikwindla yenza izintaba zibe zinhle kakhulu. Bakhuluma ngesiSuthu nangesiZulu. UNthabiseng umfundisa amagama esiSuthu, futhi uNkosiyethu umfundisa amagama esiZulu. Bahleka kakhulu uma enza amaphutha.

UMajozi uyakhanuka. Uthi: "Nami ngifuna inkosazana enhle njengoNthabiseng." UNkosiyethu uthi: "Ungakhanuki, mngane wami. Funda isiSuthu, noma isiShona!" UMajozi uyahleka, futhi akasakhanuki.

Ekupheleni kukaNhlaba uNthabiseng uthi kuNkosiyethu: "Ngiyakuthanda. Unogazi, futhi uyawahlonipha amasiko abeSuthu." UNkosiyethu uyajabula kakhulu. Ngonyaka ozayo bazovakashela umndeni kaNthabiseng eMaseru.

Imibuzo:
Kwenzekani ezintabeni ngoNhlaba?
Ikwindla iyafika, utshani buba nsundu, futhi ebusuku kuyabanda.
UNthabiseng ungubani?
UngumSuthu ovela eMaseru, futhi ungumfundisi omusha esikoleni.
Kungani uNthabiseng ekhuluma isiShona?
Ngoba wafunda eHarare.
UNkosiyethu wenzani ukuze aqomise uNthabiseng?
Ufunda isiSuthu, futhi umbingelela ngesiSuthu.
Kungani uMajozi ekhanuka?
Ngoba naye ufuna inkosazana enhle njengoNthabiseng.
